cover_html:
5 PROMPTS · REVIEWS
Get more
5 star reviews
SAMPLE · MOBILE DETAILING · TEXT THREAD
Car looks brand new. Thank you!
So glad! Would you leave us a quick Google review? Here is the link.
5 Claude prompts to ask every customer, the honest way. Swipe ▸

slides.title: Ask *right after* the job
slides.prompt: Write a 2 sentence text asking [name] for a Google review of today's [job]. Mention one detail from the job, add my review link [link], keep it warm with no pressure. Do not offer anything in return.
slides.why: Google does not allow discounts or freebies in exchange for a review.

slides.title: Ask *everyone*
slides.prompt: Here are this week's finished jobs: [name, service, day]. Draft one short review ask for each customer, with the same link for all, and one personal detail in each so none read like a copy.
slides.why: Google says do not ask only the happy customers. Ask everyone the same way.

slides.title: Make a *thank you card*
slides.prompt: Write the text for a small card I hand over at the end of a job: one line of thanks, one line asking for a Google review, and a spot for my review QR code. Under 25 words, in my voice: [paste 2 texts I sent].
slides.why: Your Google Business Profile gives you a review link and QR code to share.

slides.title: Reply to a *5 star*
slides.prompt: Reply to this review in 2 sentences: thank [name], mention the [job] they wrote about, and sound like me: [paste 2 old replies]. No sales pitch and no stock phrase I used before.
slides.why: Google advises short, conversational replies, not the same thank you on every review.

slides.title: Answer a *1 star*
slides.prompt: Here is a bad review and what really happened: [notes]. Draft a calm public reply: thank them, own what we got wrong, and give my number to fix it. No customer details, no arguing.
slides.why: Your reply is public. US rules ban baseless threats to get a bad review taken down.

cta.gift: Free Front Desk Starter: replies to customers in your voice.
cta.small: Free in your DMs. *It drafts, you send.*

bg_facts: Share your review link or QR code.
Ask every customer the same way.
No freebies in exchange for reviews.
